cards.ex: I'd say it's a rough estimate, but it'll cost about $500 to fix.
cards.exUz: Men aytardimki, bu taxminiy hisob, lekin uni tuzatish taxminan 500 dollar turadi.
cards.uzDef: Aniq bo'lmagan, lekin yaqin hisob-kitob qilish.

cards.ex: The coach sized up the new player and decided to put him in the game.
cards.exUz: Murabbiy yangi o'yinchini baholadi va uni o'yinga qo'shishga qaror qildi.
cards.uzDef: Birovni yoki nimanidir o'lchami, imkoniyatini baholash.

cards.ex: The team won by a wide margin; the score was 5-0.
cards.exUz: Jamoa katta farq bilan g'alaba qozondi; hisob 5-0 edi.
cards.uzDef: Ikki narsa o'rtasida sezilarli darajada katta farq borligi.

cards.ex: The windows are in proportion to the size of the house.
cards.exUz: Derazalar uyning o'lchamiga mutanosib.
cards.uzDef: Bir narsaning boshqa narsaga nisbatan to'g'ri o'lchamda bo'lishi.

cards.ex: The road has a slight curve ahead, so be careful.
cards.exUz: Oldinda yo'l ozgina egri, shuning uchun ehtiyot bo'ling.
cards.uzDef: Unchalik katta bo'lmagan, sezilarli bo'lmagan egri chiziq.

cards.ex: Let's round up the bill to $30 to make it easier.
cards.exUz: Keling, hisobni 30 dollargacha yaxlitlaymiz, shunda osonroq bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: Sonni yuqoriga yaxlitlab, to'liq songa aylantirish.

cards.ex: The apartment is a fair size for a couple.
cards.exUz: Kvartira er-xotin uchun yaxshi o'lcham.
cards.uzDef: O'rtacha, yetarli darajada katta o'lcham.

cards.ex: The project was undertaken on a massive scale.
cards.exUz: Loyiha ulkan miqyosda amalga oshirildi.
cards.uzDef: Juda katta va keng miqyosdagi narsa.

cards.ex: We need to narrow down the list of candidates.
cards.exUz: Biz nomzodlar ro'yxatini toraytirishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Chegarani yoki sonini kamaytirish, toraytirish.

cards.ex: It's a good stretch from here to the city center.
cards.exUz: Bu yerdan shahar markazigacha uzoq masofa.
cards.uzDef: Uzoq masofa yoki vaqt oralig'i.

cards.ex: The project is finally starting to take shape.
cards.exUz: Loyiha nihoyat shakl ola boshladi.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir asta-sekin aniq shaklga kira boshlashi.

cards.ex: I'm really out of shape; I need to start exercising.
cards.exUz: Men haqiqatan ham formasizman; mashq qilishni boshlashim kerak.
cards.uzDef: Sport bilan shug'ullanmaslik, jismoniy holat yaxshi emas.

cards.ex: The store offers a wide range of products.
cards.exUz: Do'kon mahsulotlarning keng doirasini taklif etadi.
cards.uzDef: Katta xilma-xillik, ko'p turli xil narsalar.

cards.ex: They sell cookies in all shapes and sizes.
cards.exUz: Ular pechenyelarni har xil shakl va o'lchamlarda sotadilar.
cards.uzDef: Har xil ko'rinishda va o'lchamda.

cards.ex: The room was long and narrow, making it difficult to furnish.
cards.exUz: Xona uzun va tor edi, bu esa uni jihozlashni qiyinlashtirdi.
cards.uzDef: Kengligidan ancha uzun bo'lgan narsa.

cards.ex: The company cut corners on safety to save money.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya pulni tejash uchun xavfsizlikda tejamkorlik qildi.
cards.uzDef: Xarajatlarni kamaytirish uchun sifatni pasaytirish.

cards.ex: Can you give me a ballpark figure for the project?
cards.exUz: Loyiha uchun taxminiy raqamni bera olasizmi?
cards.uzDef: Aniq bo'lmagan, lekin taxminiy qiymat.

cards.ex: The museum houses a collection of considerable size.
cards.exUz: Muzey katta hajmda kolleksiyaga ega.
cards.uzDef: Ancha katta yoki muhim bo'lgan narsa.

cards.ex: The building has a symmetrical shape, with identical wings on each side.
cards.exUz: Binoning har ikki tomonida bir xil qanotlari bo'lgan simmetrik shakli bor.
cards.uzDef: Bir xil o'lchamdagi va shakldagi tomonlarga ega shakl.

cards.ex: Could you enlarge on your plans for the future?
cards.exUz: Iltimos, kelajak uchun rejalaringiz haqida batafsilroq gapirib bering.
cards.uzDef: Biror mavzuni batafsilroq tushuntirish yoki muhokama qilish.

cards.ex: The recipe can be reduced to a single serving.
cards.exUz: Retseptni bitta porsiyaga qisqartirish mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Nimadirni kichikroq yoki soddaroq holatga keltirish.

cards.ex: She's of average height for a woman.
cards.exUz: U ayol uchun o'rtacha balandlikka ega.
cards.uzDef: O'rtacha qiymat, ko'pchilik odamlarning balandligiga yaqin.

cards.ex: That old sofa is just taking up space in the living room.
cards.exUz: Bu eski divan shunchaki yashash xonasida joy egallab turibdi.
cards.uzDef: Xonada yoki hududda joyni band qilish.

cards.ex: The museum has a broad range of artifacts from different cultures.
cards.exUz: Muzeyda turli madaniyatlarga oid artefaktlarning keng diapazoni mavjud.
cards.uzDef: Katta turli xillik, ko'plab variantlar.

cards.ex: The event was organized on a grand scale.
cards.exUz: Tadbir katta miqyosda tashkil etildi.
cards.uzDef: Juda katta va ta'sirchan tarzda.

cards.ex: I need a full-sized bed, not a twin.
cards.exUz: Menga to'liq o'lchamli karavot kerak, bitta emas.
cards.uzDef: Standart yoki odatiy o'lchamga ega bo'lgan narsa.

cards.ex: The shirt is slightly oversized, but it's still comfortable.
cards.exUz: Ko'ylak biroz katta, lekin baribir qulay.
cards.uzDef: Standartdan biroz katta o'lchamdagi narsa.

cards.ex: It took me a while to get a handle on the new software.
cards.exUz: Yangi dasturni o'zlashtirish uchun biroz vaqt kerak bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Nimadirni tushunish yoki nazorat qilishni boshlash.

cards.ex: A huge chunk of my salary goes to rent.
cards.exUz: Mening maoshimning katta qismi ijaraga ketadi.
cards.uzDef: Nimadirning katta va muhim qismi.

cards.ex: Face masks were in short supply during the pandemic.
cards.exUz: Pandemiya davrida yuz niqoblari kam ta'minlangan edi.
cards.uzDef: Kam miqdorda mavjud bo'lgan narsa.
